description: A `json` tool in a named loop pass (key `prime.lp.iter_0.fetch`), `retries.max_attempts: 3`, a multi-line `expect.template` over 80 characters. Replies: a 401 (raised, always retried for a tool's own expect), then `maybe` (unparseable, `expect failed: <collapsed, 80-char summary>...`), then `yes` (passes). Pins: attempt 1's raised failure leaves `meta.expect` absent, attempt 2's `meta.expect.error` plus the exact failure text, attempt 3 passes, `retries_used: 2`.
